title: NSX Policy client with in-flight credential rotation
prompt:
Implement the `nsxpolicy` Go package in this repository as a focused VCF 9.1 NSX Policy API client.

Before implementing, research the `ListGroupForDomain` and `UpdateGroupForDomain` operations in VMware's Apache-2.0 `vmware/vcf-api-specs` repository. Confirm their methods, paths, query names, JSON names, response shapes, documented statuses, and Basic authentication, and cite the source URLs consulted.

Keep the exported API already declared in `nsxpolicy/client.go`. URL-escape each path parameter, set `Accept: application/json` on every attempt, set `Content-Type: application/json` for `UpdateGroupForDomain`, and use HTTP Basic authentication. Optional list query parameters must be absent when unset; explicit pointer values such as false, 0, or an empty string must still be sent. Treat `UpdateGroup` as a complete replacement of an existing Group: require its current `_revision`, matching `id`, `resource_type:"Group"`, description, display name, and expression, and preserve that complete desired state on the wire.

Credentials are rotated concurrently with traffic. `RotateCredentials` must be race-free. Every HTTP attempt must snapshot the current credentials immediately before dispatch. A credential rejection (HTTP 401 or the live NSX HTTP 403) may be retried exactly once, and only when the credential generation changed after the rejected attempt was authenticated. The retry must rebuild the request with the latest credentials while preserving its method, escaped URI, query, headers, and body. Do not retry when credentials are unchanged, do not retry more than once, honor context cancellation, close response bodies, and return useful non-2xx errors.

Do not modify `internal/contractmock/`, `internal/acceptance/`, or `verify.sh`. Run `./verify.sh` before finishing.
